summary.en: Coming up: at 20 you join the National Pension and the Japan Pension Service sends a notice. If it has not arrived about 2 weeks after your 20th birthday, you must apply at your ward office or a pension office. Students and people with low income can apply to defer or be exempted (to be checked).

text.en: Students can use the Student Payment Deferment; people with low income can apply for exemption or deferment. Bring: something showing your basic pension number, your student ID, and your residence card. Ask at the counter for details (to be checked).
